project.name: rmm_adapter_model
project.description:
The tool-neutral transfer model of the adapter contract (package com.io_elements): the Element* classes with which an adapter passes artifacts, relationships, comments and attachments in both directions, together with their typed fields and identifiers. Part of the contract: the host shares this package with every plugin through the class loader of the contract.
Also the mapping (io_mapping: IoMapping and the reader of the mapping file, IoMappingJsonReader): the TCK reads the mapping template of an adapter with exactly the reader that the host uses later.
A module of its own, so that the contract (rmm_adapter_api) brings nothing of the host along.
